title: Delivery & Pickup Appointments: Fulfillment Methods and Their Service Areas
content:
Every Kestrel Auto vehicle reaches its buyer through Delivery & Pickup Appointments under exactly one of six fulfillment methods. Each method has its own entry conditions: how the handover takes place, and which buyers, distances or purchases the method can serve.

## Entry conditions by method

| Fulfillment method | How the handover takes place | Entry condition | Maximum distance from the hub the method serves |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Hub Pickup | The buyer collects the vehicle at a Kestrel hub | No limit on the buyer's distance from the hub | 0 miles (a pickup method) |
| Kestrel Vending Tower Pickup | The buyer collects the vehicle from a Kestrel vending tower with a coin token | A Kestrel vending tower must be in the buyer's market | 0 miles (a pickup method) |
| Kestrel Fly & Drive | The buyer travels to the hub holding the vehicle and drives it home | The buyer is at least 250 miles one way from the hub | 0 miles (a pickup method) |
| Kestrel Local Home Delivery | Kestrel delivers to the buyer's address on a single-car hauler | Up to 100 miles from the hub | 100 miles |
| Kestrel Extended-Zone Delivery | Kestrel delivers beyond the local zone | From 101 to 250 miles from the hub | 250 miles |
| Kestrel Enclosed White-Glove Delivery | Enclosed single-vehicle transport and an in-person walkthrough | The purchase is in the Kestrel Premium Certified or Kestrel Factory Certified program, and the address is up to 600 miles from the hub | 600 miles |

The last column is the method's service radius: the greatest distance from the hub the method serves. A figure of 0 marks a pickup method, where the vehicle is collected at a Kestrel location rather than brought to the buyer's address.

## Reading the table

**Pickup methods.** Kestrel Hub Pickup, Kestrel Vending Tower Pickup and Kestrel Fly & Drive hand the vehicle over at a Kestrel location. Hub Pickup has no distance limit; Vending Tower Pickup depends on a tower being in the buyer's market; Fly & Drive is open only to buyers at least 250 miles one way from the hub.

**Delivered methods.** Kestrel Local Home Delivery, Kestrel Extended-Zone Delivery and Kestrel Enclosed White-Glove Delivery bring the vehicle to the buyer. Their reach is set by the service radius, and White-Glove is further limited to the two purchase programs named above.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical addresses)

- An address exactly 100 miles from the hub is within Local Home Delivery's reach. An address 101 miles away is beyond it and falls in the Extended-Zone range of 101 to 250 miles.
- An address 250 miles from the hub is the furthest Extended-Zone Delivery serves. At 251 miles, the only delivered method in the table that still reaches the address is Enclosed White-Glove Delivery, which serves up to 600 miles and only Kestrel Premium Certified or Kestrel Factory Certified purchases.
- A buyer 240 miles one way from the hub is short of the 250 miles Fly & Drive requires. A buyer 250 miles away meets it.
